acceptance_tests.criterion: A valid all-complete checklist produces byte-for-byte deterministic Markdown and exits zero.
A valid incomplete checklist identifies incomplete items deterministically and exits two.
Malformed JSON, unknown fields, duplicate identifiers, and invalid types fail closed without partial output.
Input order, Unicode handling, and line endings produce the documented canonical output on every supported run.
Prompt-injection strings, Markdown control characters, and HTML-like content remain escaped inert data.
The executable performs no network calls and writes no file other than an explicitly requested output path.
The Inspector report and deterministic CI evidence bind to the same exact Builder commit SHA.
The release artifact is reproducible, checksummed, version-recorded, and recoverable by exact S3 object version.

feature.deliverable: A Python 3.12 standard-library command-line tool that validates a local JSON release-readiness checklist and emits deterministic escaped Markdown plus a documented process exit code.
feature.name: deterministic_release_readiness_checklist
feature.objective: Prove the Factory can plan, build, independently inspect, release, and recover one deliberately small Python 3.12 artifact without privileged data or unrelated product complexity.
